The orthorhombic Pnma phase, Zr₄Be₂O₁₀ (Zr₂BeO₅), has a unit cell containing 16 atoms across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Be, O, and Zr centers, with each Be and Zr surrounded by six O neighbors and each O by two Be and four Zr neighbors. The resulting neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between O-centered octahedra, edge-sharing between Zr-centered octahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Be- and Zr-centered octahedra.
